summary_en: Katakura Industries raised its dividend forecast for the year ending December 2026 by 10 yen per share to 70 yen, citing improved business performance and financial conditions. The company targets a total payout ratio of approximately 60% of parent company net income, excluding special factors, balancing stable dividends with opportunistic share buybacks.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Katakura Industries announced on November 16, 2026 that its Board of Directors resolved to revise the dividend forecast for the year ending December 2026. The company increased its forecast for the year-end dividend from 60 yen per share to 70 yen per share, representing a 10 yen increase.

The revision reflects improved business performance and financial conditions evaluated comprehensively by management. The company stated that it positions sustainable growth and enhancement of long-term corporate value, combined with profit returns to shareholders, as an important management strategy. While aiming to maintain stable dividends, the company also implements opportunistic share buybacks to improve capital efficiency.

Management targets a total return ratio of approximately 60% of parent company net income attributable to parent company shareholders, excluding special factors such as temporary losses or gains that cause significant fluctuations in net income. The dividend increase aligns with this shareholder return framework.
